baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ayman, balighah, ila yawm al-qiyamah, and lakum lama tahkumun links an oath, its temporal reach, and the addressees' judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: A sworn pledge functions as title: it must originate against Us, remain effective to the terminal event, and guarantee the claimants whatever verdict they award themselves. The question exposes the extraordinary chain of authority required by their conclusion.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch supplies a sworn pledge and makes it the alleged legal title for the promised outcome.
Reaching a limit gives the alleged pledge continuity all the way to its stated terminus.
The event-day branch makes the endpoint a consequential occasion rather than a neutral calendar date.
Resurrection and standing before the Lord identify the terminal occasion at which the title would have to remain valid.
Adjudication supplies the self-awarded verdict that the alleged oath is asked to guarantee.

changed_reading.before: A generic question about promises that let the addressees have what they want.
changed_reading.after: A demand for the sworn title under which the claimants could bind God through resurrection to honor their own verdict.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prepositional polarity lakum, alayna and the final tahkumun can stage a transfer of authority from Us to you.
baseline_models.mechanism: The alleged oaths are read as a delegation of rightful force. To support the conclusion, that delegation would have to be fully effective and place unrestricted disposal of outcomes in the addressees' hands.

activation_trace.role: Right-hand power and rightful force turn the alleged oath into an instrument of authority.
Complete, non-deficient force makes the supposed authorization total rather than partial.
Delegation and entrusted decision supply the precise authority that the addressees would need for whatever they decide to become theirs.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies a favorable promise.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks whether God ever delegated open-ended disposal, exposing the missing jurisdiction behind the favorable claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Balighah ila yawm gives the oath a movement toward a dated endpoint, while qiyamah and tahkumun supply standing and decisiveness there.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath behaves like a term instrument: issued now, carried across an open span, and alleged to mature into a firm judgment when creatures stand. This differs from mere duration because the endpoint is where the claim becomes executable.

activation_trace.role: The sworn pledge supplies the instrument whose future performance is in question.
Arrival at a measured endpoint turns duration into maturity at a term.
An open span of time supplies the interval across which the instrument allegedly remains alive.
The resurrection standing supplies the maturity event rather than merely naming a distant future.
Firmness and decisiveness make the alleged benefit executable at maturity.

changed_reading.before: The oath simply lasts until the Resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The oath is imagined as maturing at the Resurrection into an executable entitlement to the claimants' chosen result.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ayman, balighah, and tahkumun can activate a hand-rein-bridle mechanism while remaining attached to words 3, 5, and 12.
baseline_models.mechanism: Right-hand force grips, the horseman extends the rein to accelerate, and the bridle checks motion. Together they form a sarcastic control image: the addressees would need to hold the reins of the divine commitment, releasing or restraining outcomes to match their judgment.

activation_trace.role: The right hand as power supplies the controlling grip in the image.
The horseman extending the reins to increase speed supplies the releasing motion of control.
The restraining bridle supplies the opposite checking motion and turns judgment into imagined control of the course.

changed_reading.before: The addressees merely choose an outcome.
changed_reading.after: The question briefly pictures them as holding divine reins, able to accelerate or check outcomes until reality follows their choice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier pairing of habitual oath-making with abasement removes evidentiary weight from oath abundance. The focus therefore does not ask whether the addressees can produce many oaths, but whether any oath truly issued from God and binds Him.

activation_trace.role: The focus oath is the alleged title whose credibility is being tested.
Literal oath-taking supplies the earlier image of oath proliferation and weakens quantity as proof.
Lowliness and weakness attach discredit to the habitual oath-maker, sharpening the provenance test in the focus.

structural_cues: The discredited oath-maker appears before the focus asks for oaths that are specifically alayna, against Us.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath-taking joined to abasement and a later demand for oaths from Us; I infer that the first scene discounts merely human oath volume, while the live alternative is that it only characterizes one opponent.

changed_reading.before: Possession of emphatic oaths could itself establish the claim.
changed_reading.after: Oaths are cheap unless their divine provenance and binding direction can be shown; plurality intensifies the challenge rather than the proof.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden owners convert a self-sworn plan, exclusion of the poor, and felt capacity into an imagined entitlement to the crop. Their failed oath becomes a concrete counterfeit of the focus oath: human resolve cannot create an obligation upon God or guarantee what its makers decide.

activation_trace.role: The focus oath supplies the alleged divine title that the garden oath counterfeits.
Entrusted disposal names the authority the owners assume without actually receiving it.
An oath apportioned among its parties supplies the owners' mutually reinforced plan.
The abasement of poverty identifies the vulnerable person whom their asserted entitlement excludes.
Prevention and contraction supply the exclusionary purpose carried by the oath.
Effective capacity supplies the owners' confidence that intention can force the result.

structural_cues: The garden sequence moves from swearing to covert exclusion to confident execution and then immediate loss.
The garden oath is made by the owners, whereas 68:39 demands an oath whose liability lies upon Us.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the owners' oath, exclusionary aim, and confidence followed by failure; I infer that this enacted failure tests the same authority claim as 68:39, while an alternative is that it serves only as a moral analogy rather than a direct legal parallel.

changed_reading.before: The focus challenges an abstract claim to a favorable future.
changed_reading.after: The focus challenges the exact mistake enacted by the garden owners: treating one's oath-backed decision as power over a result that remains God's to give.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disputed judgment is not undefined preference. It would make the submitted and the culpable share one outcome, collapsing a moral distinction by fiat. The alleged oath is thus the missing authority for an act of category equalization.

activation_trace.role: Adjudication anchors the addressees' choice as a verdict about differentiated classes.
The oath is the alleged warrant needed to make that verdict binding.
Making something enter a state supplies the proposed operation of rendering two classes alike.
Freedom from defect marks one side of the distinction the judgment would erase.
Culpability and offense mark the opposed class and make equal treatment a substantive verdict.
The immediately preceding act of adjudication identifies the focus repetition as continued cross-examination of that verdict.

structural_cues: 68:35 poses the class comparison, 68:36 challenges how they judge, and 68:39 repeats the judgment clause after testing possible warrants.
The branchless k-y-f interrogative in 68:36 intensifies scrutiny of method but supplies no branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two contrasted classes, an act of making, and repeated judgment language; I infer that the focus oath would have to authorize their equalization, while the alternative is a broader challenge to any self-favoring eschatological verdict.

changed_reading.before: Whatever you judge means any preferred reward.
changed_reading.after: Whatever you judge is the attempted fiat by which moral categories are flattened and the favorable class assignment is guaranteed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence tests two forms of title in turn: a written enactment that can be studied and an oath binding upon God. Both would have to contain the same implausible clause granting the claimants whatever they select.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies the second alleged instrument of title after the written one.
Reaching the limit makes the oral instrument as durable as the claimed written rule.
A written enactment that imposes judgment or decree supplies the first possible documentary title.
Following a text through reading and memorization supplies the means by which its alleged clause would be verified.
Choosing among goods supplies the beneficiary-controlled option that both alleged instruments would guarantee.

structural_cues: The parallel clauses in 68:38 and 68:39 repeat lakum and lama around two different proposed warrants: a book and oaths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a studied book, beneficiary choice, and then enduring oaths; I infer a documentary-versus-sworn evidentiary ladder, while the alternative is simple rhetorical accumulation without technical instrument contrast.

changed_reading.before: The book and the oaths are separate rhetorical impossibilities.
changed_reading.after: They are alternative instruments offered for inspection, each supposedly carrying the same beneficiary-written entitlement clause.

context_deltas.mechanism: After asking for the instrument, the discourse asks for its human guarantor and associated parties, then tests performance against truth. The focus becomes one stage in a burden-of-proof ladder: instrument, responsible underwriter, co-parties, production, verification.

activation_trace.role: The sworn pledge supplies the instrument whose backing must be demonstrated.
Adjudication supplies the favorable result for which proof and backing are demanded.
Assuming a guarantee supplies the responsible underwriter demanded immediately after the oath.
Participation supplies co-parties who would have to appear and support the claim.
Fulfillment of a promise in action converts asserted truth into a production test.

structural_cues: 68:40-41 follow the focus by demanding first a responsible person and then the alleged partners themselves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies guarantee, partnership, appearance, and truth-performance after the oath question; I infer a procedural escalation of proof, while the alternative is a sequence of independent challenges to different beliefs.

changed_reading.before: 68:39 asks only whether a promise exists.
changed_reading.after: 68:39 is the instrument-production stage of a hearing that next demands an underwriter and co-parties able to perform the claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The named Day is where covering is removed, parties are summoned, and embodied compliance is attempted but unavailable. Thus an oath reaching the Day is not merely unexpired; it reaches a performance hearing where entitlement is tested against capacity to answer the call.

activation_trace.role: Arrival at the endpoint carries the alleged oath into the later performance scene.
A severe event-day makes the term an active proceeding rather than a date label.
Resurrection standing locates the proceeding in the focus construction.
Removal of a covering supplies disclosure at the alleged instrument's maturity.
A verbal summons supplies the call to perform rather than merely receive a benefit.
Submission and lowering supply the demanded performance that tests their posture.
Capacity to perform supplies the decisive failure: they cannot do what the summons requires.

structural_cues: The focus's ila yawm is answered three verses later by yawm followed by disclosure, summons, demanded action, and inability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a term reaching the Day and then a failed summoned performance; I infer that the Day functions like a maturity hearing, while the alternative is that the later scene only specifies the Day without extending the legal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The oath would remain valid until a distant deadline.
changed_reading.after: The oath would have to survive disclosure and a performance hearing at which its supposed beneficiaries cannot answer the summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gradual taking, extended time, and a solid counter-plan reverse the apparent value of an oath lasting to the Day. Long duration is not durable privilege; it can be the runway along which concealed enforcement advances degree by degree until it reaches its target.

activation_trace.role: Reaching an endpoint anchors the later gradual process as an alternative account of what duration accomplishes.
An open span of time supplies the interval that can be mistaken for favor.
Taking by successive degrees supplies the hidden forward process operating during delay.
Extension of time supplies apparent respite and the temporal medium of enforcement.
A concealed plan supplies the reversal by which respite serves an outcome opposite to the claimants' expectation.
Extended solidity makes the counter-plan, not the alleged oath, the truly durable force.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 place imperceptible progression and granted time immediately after the Day scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stepwise taking, temporal extension, concealed planning, and solidity; I infer the arrow from respite to eventual enforcement, while the alternative is that these verses threaten present deniers without specifically reinterpreting the focus term.

changed_reading.before: Length to the Day would prove the permanence of the claimants' privilege.
changed_reading.after: Length can conceal an opposing process: the interval itself carries firm enforcement toward them rather than carrying their entitlement for them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's lakum and alayna polarity reads like creditor and obligor language. The following wage, attached debt, burden, hidden account, and writing cues expose the claim as an imaginary ledger in which God owes an unlimited credit entered by the beneficiaries' own judgment.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies the alleged obligation entered against Us.
Open disposal lets the supposed creditors set the size and kind of their own credit.
Compensation for work supplies the neighboring question of whether any payment is actually due.
A financial liability that adheres supplies the debt relation implicit in putting an oath alayna.
A load made heavy supplies the felt burden of the alleged liability.
Concealment from sight supplies the inaccessible ledger from which the claimants pretend to know the balance.
Writing that establishes a binding judgment supplies the imagined entry that would prove the debt.

structural_cues: The pronoun alignment of for you and upon Us in 68:39 is followed by questions about wage, financial burden, access to the unseen, and writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies obligation-like prepositions followed by wage, debt, burden, hidden knowledge, and writing; I infer a creditor-ledger mechanism, while the alternative is that the financial and unseen questions independently test the messenger and the deniers.

changed_reading.before: The addressees claim a promise of favorable treatment.
changed_reading.after: They act as self-authorized creditors, alleging that God carries a debt whose unlimited balance they themselves enter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command assigns judgment to your Lord and requires the messenger to remain restrained before it. This answers the focus's imagined delegation: tahkumun does not name valid jurisdiction but the addressees' attempted occupation of the Lord's decision seat.

activation_trace.role: Delegated decision names the authority whose existence the focus hypothetically tests.
Rightful force supplies the authority the addressees claim to possess.
Holding the self back from agitation supplies the proper human posture before judgment.
Adjudication reappears explicitly as the judgment belonging to the Lord.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty identify the actual holder of adjudicative jurisdiction.

structural_cues: Tahkumun in 68:39 is later answered by li-hukmi rabbika in 68:48, reversing the possessor of judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same judgment root first with the addressees and later with the sovereign Lord, plus a command of restraint; I infer a jurisdictional correction, while the alternative is that the later phrase concerns only the timing of punishment.

changed_reading.before: The focus merely rejects the outcome the addressees selected.
changed_reading.after: The focus rejects their jurisdiction to select it: judgment is the Lord's, and even His messenger waits under it rather than scripting it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A real favorable reversal occurs when grace catches up before punitive casting and is followed by divine selection. This supplies a rival causal chain to the alleged oath: benefit comes by an overtaking gift and the Lord's choice, not by a beneficiary-controlled entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Reaching an endpoint anchors the question of which force arrives in time to determine the result.
Blessing and good fortune open a gift reading that contrasts with oath-based entitlement.
Catching and reaching supplies the timely interception that changes the threatened outcome.
A good-state gift supplies the actual favorable cause rather than a debt owed to its recipient.
Casting away supplies the adverse endpoint intercepted by grace.
Selection and drawing near supply the Lord-controlled favorable resolution after interception.

structural_cues: The conditional rescue in 68:49 precedes the Lord's act of choosing in 68:50; the beneficiary does not dictate either act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grace overtaking before expulsion and then divine selection; I infer this as a rival causal model to sworn entitlement, while the alternative is that the narrative only illustrates mercy to one earlier figure.

changed_reading.before: A favorable future must be secured by a binding oath possessed by the beneficiary.
changed_reading.after: The context's actual favorable reversal is unowned grace that arrives in time and is completed by the Lord's choice.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing at the opening, the studied book near the focus, and the closing reminder create a transmission frame. In it, balighah can ask not only how long the oaths bind but through what attested channel any divine pledge ever reached the claimants.

activation_trace.role: Conveying a message turns the focus adjective into a provenance and delivery test alongside its durative force.
The oath supplies the purported message-content whose transmission must be shown.
The prepared writing implement supplies an attestation channel at the surah's opening.
Ordered written lines supply a durable record against which an alleged conveyed oath could be checked.
A mention functioning as a deed or document of right closes the frame with an attested claim rather than an invented private grant.

structural_cues: The surah opens with pen and writing, places a studied book directly before 68:39, and closes with the Reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing media, written lines, a nearby book, a document-of-right branch, and the focus's delivery branch; I infer a chain-of-transmission test, while the alternative is that balighah only intensifies or extends the oaths.

changed_reading.before: Balighah says only that the oaths remain binding for a long time.
changed_reading.after: Balighah also presses provenance: where is the attested communication by which such a divine oath ever reached them?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the dying-on-the-right branch is remote from the ordinary oath sense of ayman. It remains valid as a secondary activation because death and resurrection are anchored in two explicit focus roots; downstream prose should present it only as a mortality-colored echo, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ayman at word 3 can carry the rare image of death marked by laying on the right side, while qiyamah at word 8 names rising again.

activation_trace.role: Dying as being laid on the right side supplies a mortality horizon inside the oath word.
Resurrection and rising supply the far side of that mortality horizon.

changed_reading.before: The oaths cross an abstract interval ending at resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pledges are tested across the claimants' own death and rising: do they possess any guarantee that survives being laid down and stood up again?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because qiyamah conventionally activates resurrection, not pricing, and the accounting network is cross-domain. It remains anchored in the focus's q-w-m valuation branch and h-k-m adjudication, with explicit wage, debt, and weight cues nearby; downstream prose should call it an accounting overlay on final judgment, not an alternative name for the Day.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Qiyamah at word 8 shares the q-w-m inventory with valuation and exact measure, and tahkumun at word 12 supplies adjudication.

activation_trace.role: Value, appraisal, and pricing supply an accounting color to the final standing.
Exact weight and even measure supply the standard against which self-valuation is tested.
Adjudication turns valuation into a consequential final award.
Wage or compensation supplies the neighboring question of what payment is due.
Attached financial liability supplies the debit side of the valuation scene.
Measured weight supplies the material analogy for exact accounting.

changed_reading.before: The Day is only when the addressees' preferred verdict would take effect.
changed_reading.after: As an accounting overlay, it is the final valuation where they absurdly claim both to set their own worth and to dictate the award.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a later hearing idiom does not syntactically redefine balighah in 68:39. It remains unusually well anchored because the focus b-l-gh inventory itself contains the unwelcome-report branch and the later s-m-a inventory explicitly contains hearing without reaching; downstream prose should render it as a closing lexical counterpoint about reception and effect.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Balighah at word 5 carries a branch in which unwelcome news may be heard yet not reach completion.

activation_trace.role: An unwelcome report that is heard but does not reach completion supplies the focus-side half of the reception contrast.
The explicit hearing-without-reaching idiom supplies the later lexical reversal: sound arrives while effect or completion does not.
Bringing something to mind supplies the content heard and resisted at the close.

changed_reading.before: Balighah describes only an oath whose legal force reaches a remote date.
changed_reading.after: As a lexical counterpoint, the verse asks what truly reaches its end or effect: their alleged oath, or the Reminder they hear without allowing it to reach understanding.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because sufficient provision is a branch of b-l-gh rather than the normal adjective sense in the focus. It remains anchored in balighah and is activated by the surah's harvest, wealth, poverty, and wage economy; downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for reliance, not a lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Balighah at word 5 can activate the provision by which one gets through a span, here explicitly extending to the Day.

activation_trace.role: Sufficient provision supplies the image of an oath treated as rations that carry its possessor through time.
Possessing abundant wealth supplies the material confidence behind treating status as stored provision.
Earning and gathering supply the garden economy from which imagined self-sufficiency is drawn.
Wage and compensation supply a later test of whether material support is actually being exacted.

changed_reading.before: The oath is a legal guarantee lasting until the Day.
changed_reading.after: Materially, the claimants treat the alleged oath as inexhaustible provision that will carry their chosen privilege all the way to the Day.

strongest_changes: The garden owners' failed oath turns the focus from abstract denial into a tested counterfeit of divine obligation.
The book-oath-guarantor sequence reads as a procedural burden-of-proof ladder for an alleged entitlement.
The Day becomes a maturity and performance hearing, while gradual taking reverses long delay from privilege into deferred enforcement.
The wage-debt-writing sequence exposes lakum and alayna as an imaginary creditor ledger authored by its supposed beneficiaries.
The later judgment of your Lord resolves the focus as a contest over jurisdiction, not merely over the chosen result.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sustained several coexisting mechanisms from the same compact syntax: sworn title, delegated disposal, term maturity, procedural proof, debt accounting, and even a hand-rein-bridle control image. Context repeatedly changed who writes, guarantees, performs, values, and finally owns the judgment without forcing those readings into one compromise.
remaining_uncertainties: Balighah can support durability, arrival at maturity, complete force, or transmission provenance; the focus grammar does not select only one branch image.
The reins-control, mortuary, provision, and valuation activations are visibly anchored but remain branch-distant and should stay exploratory.
The procedural and accounting sequences are abductive readings of ordered cues, not explicit technical labels supplied by the packet.
The later Lord-judgment strongly reverses jurisdiction, but it may address timing and endurance as well as ownership of judgment.
